verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents issuing and distributing physical cards, including nominated and innominated cards with horizontal or vertical designs. It also documents a card design and production process, unnamed card batches handled by its logistics partner, and shipment tracking to the delivery address, so the user does not manage a manufacturer directly. The evidence does not show shipping-method selection, API endpoints for placing physical card orders, or how custom card art is supplied. Missing for 10: documented shipping-method options, explicit API endpoints for ordering physical and bulk cards, details on custom card art submission, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself
